abstract: Several flow cytometric techniques were used to study the effects of 5-bromodeoxyuridine (BrdUrd) on the growth and differentiation of mouse teratocarcinoma cells. The teratocarcinoma system mimics embryogenesis, and the stem cells of this tumor, termed embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, spontaneously differentiate in vitro to progeny that are morphologically, biochemically and biologically distinct from the EC cells. When cultures of EC cells were treated with 30 microM BrdUrd, a pleiotropic response was observed; i.e., certain parameters mimicked spontaneous differentiation but occurred 2-3 times more rapidly while others were inconsistent with, or diametric to, spontaneous differentiation. In one line of diploid EC cells in which tetraploidy accompanies spontaneous differentiation, the BrdUrd accelerated the appearance of the tetraploid population. Analysis of cell cycle distributions during the course of the BrdUrd treatment showed that virtually all of the cells had cycled 2 or more times and incorporated BrdUrd into both strands of DNA. Multiangle light-scattering and electrical impedance analyses indicated that with respect to these two parameters, cultures treated with BrdUrd for 3 days resembled spontaneously differentiating cultures of 6-8 days. However, BrdUrd treatment did not induce increases in the kinetics of esterase (EC3.1.1.) activities in teratocarcinoma cells that normally accompany spontaneous differentiation. Analysis of alkaline phosphatase (APase) EC (3.1.3.1) activities showed that unlike the decrease in APase activities which accompany spontaneous differentiation, BrdUrd treatment causes an increase in APase activities.
abstract_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞の増殖と分化に対する5-ブロモデオキシウリジン(BrdUrd)の作用を、いくつかのフローサイトメトリー技法および多角度光散乱、電気インピーダンス解析を用いて検討した。奇形癌系は胚発生を模倣するものであり、その幹細胞である胎児性癌(EC)細胞は、in vitroで自然に分化し、形態学的、生化学的、生物学的に異なる子孫細胞を生じる。EC細胞培養に30 μMのBrdUrdを処理すると、多面的な反応が認められた。すなわち、自然分化に似た指標が2～3倍速く生じる一方、自然分化と一致しない、あるいは逆行する指標もあった。二倍体EC細胞株の一つでは、自然分化に伴って生じる四倍体化が、BrdUrdにより加速された。BrdUrdで3日間処理した培養は、自然分化6～8日目の培養に類似していた。一方、自然分化に伴って通常生じるエステラーゼ活性の動態変化は誘導されなかった。アルカリホスファターゼ活性は、自然分化で低下するのとは異なり、BrdUrd処理により上昇した。
